annotation.bound_parties_text: The draft Regulation lays down uniform obligations for operators that develop, import or use AI systems, including providers, deployers, public authorities, Member States and notified bodies.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: by laying down uniform obligations for operators and guaranteeing the uniform protection of overriding reasons of public interest
annotation.dates_quote: the compromise agreement provides for 24 months with regard to most parts of the Regulation, with slightly shorter deadlines for some elements, namely 6 months for prohibitions
annotation.robot_provision_quote: The Commission adopted the proposal for a Regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act, hereinafter: the AI Act) on 21 April 2021.
